first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, so simplifying onboarding directly targets both current problems. The inherited evidence supports durable activation gains, while promotional pricing carries a documented 30-day retention risk and is less aligned with sustainable qualified revenue. Verify the onboarding and signup records before committing, then run a guarded test.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding simplification experiment focused on self-serve SMB accounts, where the evidence is applicable. Shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines. Signup simplification also improved activation and qualified revenue in SMBs, but its small retention decline and lack of replication beyond SMB require guardrails. Measure completion, activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention; do not expand if retention or downstream revenue deteriorates.
